### Gap 1 — All 15 concrete agents have zero tests

Every tier-specific agent (`OrchestratorAgent`, `MemoryAgent`, `QualityAgent`, all tier 2–5) is completely untested. The `base-agent.test.ts` uses a stub subclass and does not exercise any real agent logic.

**Missing: task routing, load balancing, health check logic (OrchestratorAgent)**

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import { OrchestratorAgent } from '../../.
